title: 1982 dream of 2060 flying CIA UFOs after nuclear war of 2034

one of the things about my dream was it

and trying I was already in an

plain: In a dream he had in 1982, a former chief at the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen says he saw himself in the year 2060, travelling with UFOs through a world already ruined by "the great nuclear war of 2034." Mowatt-Larssen tells it as his own memory of what he calls "the chameleon dream of the future," in which he was "going back and forth" in an apocalypse. Taken as he tells it, the dream would be a glimpse of a coming war.
